aries_3.summary: Impulse that swings between reckless courage and a longing for quiet.
aries_3.fullText: A degree of extremes. Placements act on impulse and swing like a pendulum, from rash, headlong courage to a wish for peace, quiet and harmony that seems out of character. Vanity is a mild risk, and so is doing too much. Relationships need real give-and-take before the promise here shows itself. Because everything tends to be all or nothing, firm self-direction is essential, both to keep hold of their own lives and to avoid being used by others.

sagittarius_11.summary: Sociable courage, blunt in speech and shrewd in tactics.
sagittarius_11.fullText: Strong social gifts, physical bravery, and a liking for athletics and the practical arts. Placements say what they think, and the bluntness causes friction and makes them a few opponents. The other half of the degree repairs the damage. They are skilled at subtlety, at strategy and at the diplomacy a social life needs, and the two sides balance.

sagittarius_12.summary: Heightened senses, with close attention to the body and the home.
sagittarius_12.fullText: The senses are sharpened here. That gives a strong appetite for physical pleasure and a good deal of energy to pursue it. Placements are often much occupied with their health and the care of the body. They are just as concerned with the house they live in, and look after it and defend it with the same attention.

sagittarius_13.summary: A test of what is valued: wisdom or outward wealth.
sagittarius_13.fullText: This degree lies near the south node of Uranus, and the tradition treats it as a trial. Placements are tested against material greed and against pretence put on for show. Growth depends on looking past external wealth. What they are asked to develop instead is real philosophical understanding, and a nonconformity that has a purpose behind it.

sagittarius_14.summary: A resourceful mind that makes obscure ideas plain.
sagittarius_14.fullText: Intellectual resourcefulness and literary talent are both strengthened. Placements take naturally to esoteric or mystical subjects and grasp them without strain. Their particular service is translation. Complicated, unconventional ideas go in, and what comes out is language that other people can follow and find meaning in.

sagittarius_15.summary: Early luck that has to be invested while it lasts.
sagittarius_15.fullText: Keen intuition, and a strong run of luck or opportunity that arrives early in life. The momentum may not hold. Past middle age it tends to fade, and placements who spent it freely have little to show. The advice is simple and practical: put early good fortune into undertakings that are worthwhile and will last.

sagittarius_16.summary: Persistence where the heart is engaged, and a need for clean air.
sagittarius_16.fullText: Drive is strong and sustained whenever affection is involved, and placements will keep going for the people they are attached to. There is a physical sensitivity in the lungs and the breathing. The lessons of the degree follow the same line: contamination, of the mind or of the surroundings, and confinement, are what it has to learn to deal with.

sagittarius_17.summary: Plain, childlike faith that carries a long way.
sagittarius_17.fullText: A pure and unpretentious faith, of the kind the saying about becoming as little children describes. On its own it is innocence. Joined to inner strength it is something more, and this simple trust lifts placements to unusual heights of inspiration and of actual accomplishment.

sagittarius_18.summary: Compassion that chooses hardship and heals by working the land.
sagittarius_18.fullText: Deep feeling for people who suffer. Placements may go looking for hardship of their own accord, or give up worldly wealth, to show that they mean it. They find their footing in agricultural work. Growing things steadies them, and brings healing of body or mind.

sagittarius_19.summary: Severe trials that forge strength, with a leaning toward martyrdom.
sagittarius_19.fullText: Intense personal ordeals and emotional struggle mark this degree, and placements can take on the part of the martyr. The tests often come through loss involving people they love, or through physical weakness, in the legs especially. Hard as they are, these are the occasions on which deep inner strength is made.

sagittarius_20.summary: A healer and organiser, at home in cooperative work.
sagittarius_20.fullText: A constructive, social degree. It favours action taken together, and also the decorative arts, literature and medicine. Placements have an inborn gift for healing and good taste to go with it. Their lives are energetic and satisfying, and are mostly spent in undertakings shared with other people.

pisces_21.summary: An intuitive mystic with conservative footings.
pisces_21.fullText: The temperament is artistic and emotionally sensitive, and intuition runs toward the mystical. What distinguishes this degree is the caution that goes with it. On the things life is founded on, placements are conservative and careful, so that deep feeling and a prudent approach are found in the same person.

pisces_22.fullText: Creative and expressive, with a quick wit and lively enthusiasm. Placements take life spontaneously and enjoy it. The work of the degree is balance. That easy, pleasure-loving approach has to be matched with self-restraint that gives it structure, and with relationships valued for what they really are.

pisces_23.summary: Psychic sight tested in the wilderness.
pisces_23.fullText: Strong psychic perception wakes here, and it has to be kept clear of material greed. The tradition compares the degree to the forty days in the wilderness. The test is a severe one. Placements must see through the illusions the world offers before they can lay claim to a reality that lies beyond them.

pisces_24.summary: Instinct and sexuality, from strict restraint to open passion.
pisces_24.fullText: The sexual and instinctual side of the nature is brought into sharp focus. It can show at either extreme: a puritanical holding-back, or deep and passionate expression. Neither settles the matter. What the degree asks is that this side be consciously understood and given its proper place in the whole person.

pisces_25.summary: A quiet, impressionable nature that needs peaceful surroundings.
pisces_25.fullText: Receptive and quiet. Placements take a strong impression from whatever is around them and are easily influenced by it. Their emotional balance is delicate. A peaceful, supportive environment protects it, and the choice of where and among whom they live matters more here than for most.

pisces_26.summary: Devotion and self-sacrifice in search of unity.
pisces_26.fullText: The personality is moved toward spiritual devotion and toward giving itself up for something greater. Placements are idealists. What they are looking for is complete unity with truths that hold everywhere, and they look for it beyond the limits the physical world sets.

pisces_27.summary: An easygoing, childlike openness to things unseen.
pisces_27.fullText: Uninhibited and childlike in disposition. Placements are open to subtle influences other people do not notice, and may have had unseen playmates when young. They are amiable and easy to be with. What they will not do is conform for the sake of it, and artificial social rules get little from them.

pisces_28.summary: A sharp, healing intellect that finds what others missed.
pisces_28.fullText: A keen and competent mind, suited to discovering nature's secrets in chemistry, anatomy and medicine. Placements have an intuitive gift for diagnosis. It lets them reach the right answer where accepted opinion has failed, and some of their discoveries save lives.

pisces_29.summary: Exacting standards, and the last details put in order.
pisces_29.fullText: This degree demands rigour. Standards are exact and everything is thought through thoroughly before it is passed. The tradition gives it a tidying purpose: what remains unsettled from the past is cleared up here, detail by detail, before a new cycle of life begins.

pisces_30.summary: The last degree: completion, and the ground cleared for Aries.
pisces_30.fullText: The zodiac closes here. The degree stands for the falling away of the separate ego, for union with the whole, and for everything gathered into a final synthesis. It is an ending that prepares a beginning, since the first spark of Aries comes directly after it.

aries_4.summary: Abundant, untamed energy that turns everything it touches to account.
aries_4.fullText: A strong, wild force of growth, sometimes called the Midas touch. Placements are like a child in charge of great power: whatever they take up produces results, and fast. The luck is plentiful and can be thrown away just as quickly. Discipline and structure are what keep it from being wasted.

aries_6.summary: Quick rise to authority, secure only if character keeps pace.
aries_6.fullText: Positions of executive leadership come early and easily to this degree. The warning concerns what the position rests on. Where short-sighted ambition takes the place of spiritual development and of real personal ties, the high standing is pretence, and it is liable to collapse suddenly.

aries_15.summary: A solitary pioneer working by tested rules.
aries_15.fullText: This degree asks for two things at once: keeping to guidelines that have been proved, and growing a protective shell around the self. Placements resemble a hermit opening up new country. They work quietly and alone, and what they produce is original and of use to society.

aries_24.summary: Intense creative impulse, clear when it is aimed at the truth.
aries_24.fullText: Creative energy is the keynote, and it is strong. Directed toward what is really true, it brings inspiration of a high order. Directed elsewhere, it brings a Neptunian sort of confusion, and placements then need to look underneath surface appearances and the images people project in order to find their way.

aries_25.summary: Inborn goodness, with serious study in later life.
aries_25.fullText: Good-natured from birth and full of vitality. Placements have little wish for material wealth. In later life they turn to serious philosophical study and gain a great deal from applying themselves to it. The tradition adds a particular note: they are helped by the loyal support of women friends.
